about: Documented differences between Traefik v3.7 and rdock that the differential test accepts (tests/conformance/traefik-diff/harness.py, ADR-0033). Each entry needs a reason and a source; additions are reviewed like any other change of the documented Traefik subset (docs/10-stability.md). `field` is a regular expression over the compared fields (status, backend, seen.path, seen.header.<name>, response.header.<name>); `option` names the coverage-table row whose stated difference the entry covers; `when` narrows it to values (`*` any, `re:<pattern>` a regular expression over the whole value). Entries without `option` are about answers the proxy writes itself, not about a label.

differences.reason: `tls=true` takes an automatic certificate in rdock and Traefik's default or stored one; the harness gives both proxies the same certificate and does not compare certificates, so nothing is observed.
A resolver's name is not kept (one ACME account); ACME is off in the test and certificates are not compared, so nothing is observed.

With `compress=true`, rdock prefers zstd, br, gzip and compresses common text types; Traefik prefers gzip, br, zstd and compresses every type not excluded. whoami's answers are below the 1024-byte minimum, so the difference shows only on larger answers.
Without `burst`, rdock's burst is `average` and Traefik's is 1, so Traefik refuses a quick second request that rdock admits. The cases set `burst` where the matrix could reach the limit.

A request no router matches is answered by the proxy itself. Traefik writes its 404 with Go's http.Error, which sets `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`; rdock's own 404 carries no such header. The status agrees; only this header of the proxy's own answer differs. First seen in the run of 2026-11-14 (16 of 61 requests).
differences.source: https://pkg.go.dev/net/http#Error (read 2026-11-14); the traefik-diff run of commit ebbddb9

differences.reason: rdock's Basic challenge names the charset it decodes credentials with (RFC 7617 section 2.1); Traefik's challenge has the realm only. Clients treat both as a Basic challenge for the realm.
